outcome: Severity of hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN)
Need for neonatal treatment for HDFN
cohort: 130 pregnant women in Iceland with RhD alloimmunization between 1996 and 2015
finding: In about half of cases, RhD alloimmunization was caused by the index pregnancy and discovered in the third trimester.
mod_finding: Higher anti-D titers were associated with cesarean sections.
